reason: A DeepSeek Harness guardrail plugin that enforces configurable per-turn limits on supported structured file mutations, mutation calls, and submitted UTF-8 bytes before tool execution.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Agent 对受支持的结构化文件修改设置每轮文件数、调用数和 UTF-8 字节数预算，并在超限前拒绝调用。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness guardrail that applies per-turn budgets for supported structured file mutations, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes, rejecting calls before they exceed the configured limits.

capabilities: Intercepts supported structured file-mutation tool calls
Tracks per-turn distinct-file, mutation-call, and UTF-8 payload-byte budgets
Rejects calls that exceed configured limits before tool execution
Maintains in-memory budget reservations per agent turn
